limitations: The frozen Phase 5.7 model is reused without retraining.
The historical training scaler parameters were not reconstructed.
The six historical normalization tensors missing from the checkpoint are treated as identity transformations.
OOD thresholds are laboratory-baseline statistical thresholds.
Diagonal Mahalanobis is used instead of a full covariance estimator.
Local perturbation sensitivity is an uncertainty proxy, not Bayesian uncertainty.
Synthetic laboratory cyber-physical scenarios do not establish real-world attack performance.
